[SWS_DM_01399] SOVD operation attribute asynchronous_execution
⌈
If the DiagnosticRoutine only has a DiagnosticStartRoutine and no Diag-
nosticStopRoutine and no DiagnosticRequestRoutineResults configured,
the attribute asynchronous_execution of the corresponding SOVD operation shall
be false, else the attribute shall be true.
⌋

⌈

ticSovdOperationStart (DiagnosticSovdOperation.start), the attribute asyn-
